# Browser Testing Gotchas

> Known browser testing and pointer event patterns that cause silent failures or hard-to-debug errors.

## Entries

- [Pointer event handoff between trigger and popup requires explicit handling](pointer-event-relatedtarget.md): Chromium sends mouseout after pointerleave even within the same layout; check relatedTarget to know if pointer entered a related element. MEDIUM.
- [Browser tests miss rendering-order and lazy-stylesheet bugs](browser-tests-visual-vs-markup.md): DOM tests pass for unstyled markup; lazy-loaded stylesheets, computed layout, and text wrapping require visual harnesses with real browser rendering. HIGH.
